issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks Farm.addAnimal(Animal) with private visibility ('-'), but the starter Main.java (template) calls farm.addAnimal(...) and the provided solution implements addAnimal as public. This inconsistency between the UML and the code will confuse students about whether they should implement addAnimal as public (so it can be used from Main) or private, and it may block following the example usage in Main.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: update the UML in the problem statement to show addAnimal(Animal) as public ('+') to match the intended usage in Main and the solution, or alternatively change the example usage in Main to use a different mechanism if addAnimal is intentionally meant to be private. Preferably declare addAnimal as public in the specification and template so students implement it accordingly.
